phases.title: Finish the domain move
items: Search Console: open the old .vercel.app property → Settings → Change of address → divinefabtech.com.
Change the website link on your Google Business Profile, Justdial, Instagram and Facebook to www.divinefabtech.com.
GA4: mark contact_click and form_start as key events.
Add the site to Bing Webmaster Tools by importing it from Search Console.

phases.title: Speed, markup, listings
items: Show the first hero slide without the fade, with fetchpriority="high"; load the Google tag after the page.
Serve the logo as a small WebP and resize the poncho photo; add three security headers.
Add geo, priceRange and sameAs (Business Profile, Justdial, the real Facebook page URL; IndiaMART once live) to LocalBusiness.
Fix the Business Profile address and categories; make Justdial match the site; remove the 'HDPE' title on JD Mart.
Create IndiaMART, TradeIndia and ExportersIndia listings that link to www.
Start the review drive: send every buyer from the last 12 months the Google review link on WhatsApp.

phases.title: Content and trust
items: Rebuild /products/poncho and /products/tarpaulins: spec tables, MOQ, lead time, packing, price-by-quantity, real factory photos.
Add an About section with the founder and team, factory photos and the story; keep only claims you can prove.
Explain the ₹20* asterisk next to the price; add 3 customer stories with photos.
Publish Gujarati and Hindi versions of the tarpaulin pages, starting with the farmer and trader pages.
Film 6 short factory videos (lamination line, GSM test, poncho stitching, packing, dispatch, colours) for YouTube and the site.

phases.title: Grow and measure
items: Run the seasonal campaigns in the calendar; track leads by channel in GA4.
Every month, add 2 guides that answer a question buyers ask on WhatsApp.
Every month, repeat the rank check and run /seo drift compare on the 6 baseline pages.
Pitch the 'best manufacturers' lists and directories named in the Authority section.
